entities.text: Ritz Carlton Hotel and Resorts Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The FIR has been lodged on 27.09.2023 before the O/C, Basistha Police Station alleging inter allia that the informant had received a phone call from a number 9891004345/9289131900 stating that the caller is from Ritz Carlton Hotels & Resorts and told that the informant had won a complementary luxury gift card and had invited him to collect it from Greenwood Hotel, Guwahati.

The informant had initially refused to go but several calls and blackmailing messages were sent,
whereupon he and his friend decided to go to the hotel and meet them.

When the informant and his friends reached the hotel, they found 7/8 persons sitting in the lounge and they approached them with some papers and asked them to sign the papers and pay Rs.3,000/- as prepaid administration fees but the informant refused to pay the same.

When they insisted to pay only taxes, on suspicion,
the informant called the police whereupon they were taken to the police station.

5. It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioners and some other employees of the company were arrested in Page No.# 4/6 connection with the said case purely on suspicion, fraud and trapping innocent people for wrongful gain.
It is also stated that the petitioners came to Guwahti to promote their company and market its hotel packages.

The said company provides packages for holiday destinations in the places like Rishikesh, Shimla, Haridwar,
Goa etc.

It books hotel accommodation for its customers for which it takes fee and in order to promote the company, it offers vouchers entitling the prospective customers, for which an administration fee of Rs.3,000/- is to be charged which is clearly mentioned in the vouchers.
6. It is further submitted that though the petitioners along with other employee requested the informant to pay Rs.3,000/- for administration fee but they refused to pay.
It has also pointed out that the FIR lodged on mere suspicion of fraud.
It is also stated that the petitioners were arrested on 28.09.2023 and since then they have been languishing in jail hazot.
Considering the background of the case, bail may be considered to the petitioner.

7. In response, Mr. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State has submitted that from the case diary, it reveals that the petitioners along with other employee of the said hotel, have collected money from the people in the name of holiday packages, hotel accommodation and other facilities but they did not provided the same.
At this stage of investigation, bail may not be considered.
8. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties.
I have also perused the case diary.
9. The allegation against the present petitioners is that when the petitioner and other employee of the said hotel approached before the informant to pay Rs.3,000/-, he refused to pay the same.
Subsequently, they asked him to pay some more money for the purpose of taxes.

Though some Page Page No.# 1/6 vs The State Of Assam on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157609897/
3 No.# 5/6 allegations were made in the case that in the name of Ritz Carlton Hotel and Resorts Pvt.
Ltd., some people have collected money to provide holiday packages, hotel accommodation and other facilities but which are not connected with the present case as alleged in the FIR.

sentences.text: 10. Considering the materials found in the case diary, this Court is of the view that further custodial detention of the accused-petitioners is not necessary in the interest of investigation of the case.

11. Accordingly, the petitioners, named above, shall be released on bail in connection with Basistha P.S. Case No. 593/2023, registered under Section 120(B)/419/420/385/468/471 IPC r/w Section 66 D of the I.T. Act, 2000, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.30,000/- each with two suitable sureties each of the like amount out of which one of the sureties should be a Government employee to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, Assam.
That being so, if the petitioners violate any of the above condition(s) in future, the learned Public Prosecutor shall apprise this Court to cancel the bail order.
14. The bail application stands disposed of accordingly.
15. Return the case diary.
